title: A kind of rubber composition and application
abstract: A kind of rubber composition, including rubber, quality is 80 120 parts, peroxide initiator, quality are 15 parts；Bridging agent, quality are 2 15 parts；Free radical absorbs release regulator, quality is 0.1 1 parts；Reinforcement and age resistor, the rubber include polybutadiene rubber, natural rubber and arbitrary one to three kind of butadiene-styrene rubber, account for more than the 70% of rubber quality.A kind of rubber composition i.e. formula of the auxiliary agent such as product crosslinking is proposed, disclosure satisfy that using tire, footwear material and wearing plate be representative from performance to the good technical scheme of industrial Applicability effect, and cost, environmental protection can be taken into account.
